findings: The Portal accepts the code and produces an annual estimate despite the two default intervals in the XML.
The detail table contains one variable spread row; it does not show the separate fixed 0.08 interval found in the XML.
This does not establish a general precedence rule for overlapping intervals or disclose the forward curve.
The VAT label and amount are recorded as displayed. No fiscal rule is inferred from this apparent inconsistency.
